   4| ESR1 was knocked down in MCF7 cells with siRNA, with 6 non-targeting controls (siNT) and 6 ESR1-targeting replicates (siESR1) profiled by RNA-seq. The raw 38,606-gene count matrix was filtered to 13,208 expressed genes under the locked analysis decision; all 12 samples passed QC and are retained.
   5| 
   6| ## The knockdown worked
   7| ESR1 transcript was reduced 87–91% across all six siESR1 replicates (mean 89%, CV 4.2%). The canonical estrogen-response program collapsed with it: GREB1 log₂FC −4.70, PGR −4.29, ESR1 itself −3.22, XBP1 −1.30, all downregulated. TFF1 was unmeasurable (filtered out as near-unexpressed). This is a textbook ESR1-loss signature.
   8| 
   9| ## The transcriptome separates cleanly
  10| PCA on log₂-CPM shows the knockdown is the dominant signal: PC1 accounts for 90% of variance and separates siNT from siESR1 with no overlap (siNT −45 to −41 vs siESR1 +39 to +47). A top-30-gene heatmap reproduces the split as two pure condition blocks with a 26-fold between-vs-within group distance ratio. No sample was misassigned to the wrong group.
  11| 
  12| ## Exploratory DE is consistent but not final
  13| The exploratory per-gene t-test on log₂-CPM gives a net-downregulatory landscape: 5,999 down vs 4,588 up at nominal p<0.05, with 9 of the top 10 genes repressed. However, these p-values are anti-conservative — 80% of all genes appear "significant" at p<0.05 — because the t-test ignores count-data variance structure. These results are for ranking and QC only; they must not be quoted as the final DE call.
  14| 
  15| ## What is outstanding and what we recommend
  16| The formal differential-expression analysis (DESeq2, design `~ group`, locked FDR) is planned but not yet run — this is the single most important next step, followed by pathway enrichment to formally quantify the estrogen-response signature. Sample QC is clean; two mild watch-items (siNT_1 at 59.8% assignment, siESR1_2 at the weakest knockdown) were checked and do not require exclusion. All code, tables, figures, and a full audit trail are in the `results/` and `figures/` directories.

import pandas as pd, numpy as np

# Recompute every number cited in executive_summary.md from the underlying tables
counts = pd.read_csv('results/GSE153250_counts_filtered.tsv', sep='\t', index_col=0)
raw = pd.read_csv('data/GSE153250_counts_matrix.tsv', sep='\t', index_col=0)
de = pd.read_csv('results/de_exploratory.tsv', sep='\t', index_col=0)
groups = pd.read_csv('data/GSE153250_sample_groups.txt', sep='\t').set_index('sample')
order=groups.index.tolist()
lib=counts.sum(axis=0); cpm=counts.div(lib,axis=1)*1e6; log2cpm=np.log2(cpm+1)
nt=[s for s in order if groups.loc[s,'group']=='siNT']
es=[s for s in order if groups.loc[s,'group']=='siESR1']

print("=== Line 4: counts ===")
print(f"raw genes={raw.shape[0]} (exec: 38,606)  filtered={counts.shape[0]} (exec: 13,208)  samples={counts.shape[1]} (exec: 12)")

print("\n=== Line 7: knockdown ===")
E='ENSG00000091831'
e=log2cpm.loc[E,order]; red=(1-2**(e[es]-e[nt].mean()))*100
print(f"ESR1 KD range={red.min():.2f}-{red.max():.2f} (exec: 87-91)  mean={red.mean():.2f} (exec: 89)")
print(f"CV of per-rep log2FC={np.std([log2cpm.loc[E,s]-e[nt].mean() for s in es],ddof=1)/abs(np.mean([log2cpm.loc[E,s]-e[nt].mean() for s in es]))*100:.1f}% (exec: 4.2%)")
print(f"GREB1={de.loc['ENSG00000196208','log2FC_siESR1_vs_siNT']:.2f} (exec: -4.70)  PGR={de.loc['ENSG00000082175','log2FC_siESR1_vs_siNT']:.2f} (exec: -4.29)  ESR1={de.loc[E,'log2FC_siESR1_vs_siNT']:.2f} (exec: -3.22)  XBP1={de.loc['ENSG00000100219','log2FC_siESR1_vs_siNT']:.2f} (exec: -1.30)")

print("\n=== Line 10: PCA ===")
pca=pd.read_csv('results/pca_coordinates.tsv',sep='\t',index_col=0)
print(f"siNT PC1 {pca[pca.group=='siNT'].PC1.min():.1f}..{pca[pca.group=='siNT'].PC1.max():.1f} (exec: -45..-41)  siESR1 {pca[pca.group=='siESR1'].PC1.min():.1f}..{pca[pca.group=='siESR1'].PC1.max():.1f} (exec: +39..+47)")

print("\n=== Line 13: DE ===")
print(f"down={int(((de.p_value<0.05)&(de.log2FC_siESR1_vs_siNT<0)).sum())} (exec: 5,999)  up={int(((de.p_value<0.05)&(de.log2FC_siESR1_vs_siNT>0)).sum())} (exec: 4,588)")
print(f"frac p<0.05 = {(de.p_value<0.05).mean()*100:.0f}% (exec: 80%)")

print("\n=== Line 16: siNT_1 ===")
fc=pd.read_csv('data/GSE153250_featureCounts_summary.txt',sep='\t',index_col=0)
fc.columns=[c.split('/')[-1].replace('_Aligned.sortedByCoord.out.bam','') for c in fc.columns]
print(f"siNT_1 assign={(fc.loc['Assigned','siNT_1']/fc['siNT_1'].sum()*100):.2f}% (exec: 59.8%)")
